verdict.rationale: New Relic documents NerdGraph, a GraphQL API for querying its data, and NRQL, a SQL-like query language explicitly positioned for troubleshooting. An official MCP server connects external AI tools to the platform and converts plain-English questions to NRQL, so an outside agent can pull this telemetry for debugging. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that traces (not just metrics/logs) are queryable via the API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an external agent debugging production this way.
